caption:
An unexpected car repair or prescription shouldn't derail your entire month. That is why a starter emergency buffer of $500 is one of the most practical tools you can build.

You do not need to save thousands overnight to feel more confident. Focus on small, repeatable steps and give your budget some breathing room.

Which of these steps can you take this week?
